title: Your New Favorite Blanket: Corner-to-Corner on the Machine
description:
This workshop takes you step-by-step through knitting a corner-to-corner blanket on the machine - from the first planning decisions all the way to the final rows.

You’ll see how to calculate size, handle shaping on the diagonal, track your progress, and manage tension and edges for a smooth, polished finish.

Throughout the workshop, you’ll notice calm, confidence-building guidance designed to make each step feel approachable.

You’ll also have access to the companion pattern and a set of Skill Builders that support the techniques shown in the video.

Whether this is your first blanket or your fiftieth, you’ll come away with a clear path and a finished piece you can be proud of.
